no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

attrs.note: datasheet - the material, colour, standards and what is in the box are the PR2VD08 product page and the specification sheet (RKSP172); the materials are the drawing's.

bottom.note: estimated - the top view again: the two ends of the manager are alike.

capacity.note: datasheet - the Cable Capacity Charts of the Space-Saving bulletin (RKCB46) give the PR2VD08 per cable at the 30 per cent recommended fill and the 50 per cent maximum, the front and the rear separately; the figures stated are the Cat 6 24 AWG 0.235 in (5.97 mm) column at 30 per cent: 440 front (734 at 50 per cent) and 274 rear (457). The Cable Capacity Calculator gives the usable areas, 63.71 and 39.73 sq in. The bulletin notes that slack spools reduce the capacity.

chassis.note: drawing - 203.2 x 2130.4 x 526.4, covers fitted: the PR2VD table's A 8.00 in [203.2], B 83.88 in [2130.4] and C 20.7 in [526.4] for the PR2VD08. The Space-Saving bulletin states 8.0 x 84.0 x 20.6 in (203 x 2130 x 523 mm).

color.note: estimated - "The manager is black" on the product page. Every image Panduit publishes of the part is a render; the doors are drawn a shade lighter than the backbone.

depth.note: estimated - the 526.4 is overall. It is drawn as a 303 front channel, a 20.4 backbone and a 203 rear channel: the plan view puts the backbone about 41 per cent of the way from the back, and the calculator's front and rear areas for the PR2VD08 (63.71 and 39.73 sq in) are in the ratio 1.6:1.

front.note: drawing - the front with the door fitted: the door, and under it the backbone with 45 fingers a side in three sections of 15 and the four holes. The `duct` guide is the channel between the finger columns, run down the height: 174.0 across, which is the 8 in less the 29.2 the calculator's front area per inch of width (9.3 sq in) leaves, ESTIMATED.

guides.note: estimated - each duct is the channel between the two finger columns of its face, run down the height (`run: y`), with the rack unit's 44.45 pitch and the 11.45 left between 33 mm fingers.

left.note: estimated - no side view of the manager without its doors is dimensioned: the backbone, and the two finger zones along it, built from the plan view and the finger columns' extent.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS. Panduit publishes the PR2VD** as a customer drawing (PDF 14V455LV-DC with a table of width, height, depth, door size and weights for every width and height; a 68 MB DXF and a DWG that were not read), the PatchRunner 2 Vertical Cable Managers specification sheet RKSP172, an installation instruction, a product page, the Space-Saving bulletin RKCB46 and the Cable Capacity Calculator. The drawing's views are read at 150 and 300 dpi. THE FIGURES THE TABLE GIVES ARE `drawing`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE PICTURES (the split of the depth between the channels, the finger's size, the holes' places) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it.

mount.note: drawing - `rack-side`, as the FS vertical ducts: the PR2VD drawing (Panduit 14V455LV-DC) draws a "free standing base" and "integrated door brackets", and the installation instruction mounts the manager beside the PatchRunner 2 and standard racks. It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 45` is the height it runs beside (the 83.88 in of the table is a 7 ft, 45 RU manager). Which side of the rack is a lab placement to say (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md).

rear.note: drawing - the rear with the door fitted, as the front: the PR2VD drawing is titled "front and rear fingers and doors". The `duct` is 162.0 across, the 8 in less the 41.2 that the calculator's rear area per inch of width (6.23 sq in) leaves, ESTIMATED. The holes pass through to this face.

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: drawing - TWO HOLLOW CHANNELS BACK TO BACK, NOT A BOX. The body is a sheet body (docs/cable-managers-design.md section 4) and its six views are elevations. The solid is what its parts build: on the front view the backbone as a well 303 deep with three sections of fingers a side and the door in it; on the rear view the backbone's back as a well 203 deep with its fingers and door; both floors open at the four 3.0 in holes.

thickness.note: estimated - no Panduit document states the steel's gauge. 1.5 is a sheet of this kind; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the rear fingers, the backbone and the front fingers, built from the plan view of the drawing and the finger lengths above.

weight.note: drawing - 24.8 kg [54.59 lb], the manager and doors unpacked, the weight column of the PR2VD table; 25.7 kg [56.59 lb] shipped.
